name: Пастки: усунення захисника + SH
description: In this lesson, material can be won by disabling a defender. Capturing, driving away, and luring away are ways to achieve this. We focus here on capturing. Just like in previous lessons, it remains important to be alert to the different defenses of the opponent.

examples.text: Correct is 1.Nxf6!. White disables the defender of the bishop. 1.Bxf6 (red arrow) does the same, but leaves the knight on d5 unprotected. Black plays 1...Bxd5 and the material balance is restored.

Just like in example 1, White has attractive options with 1.Nxf6 and 1.Bxf6. In both cases, the defender of the black bishop is captured. However, after 1.Nxf6 (red arrow) 1...gxf6, White has no time to capture the bishop on e4, as they are in check (counterattack)! Black recaptures the knight with a discovered check. Therefore, the correct move is 1.Bxf6, and White remains a piece up.

texts: Capture as many points as possible by taking more of your opponent's pieces than you lose.
